embeds.title: Previously reported papers (still in the 30-day window)

fields.name: GSExplorer: Interactive World Generation with a Persistent 3D Gaussian World State
fields.value: Horizon Robotics; listed as Project Leader) — GSExplorer is a framework for interactive world generation that pairs a video generator with a persistent 3D Gaussian Splatting scene representation.

fields.name: UniCaMo: Unified Camera and Motion Control for Video Diffusion Models
fields.value: Qualcomm AI Research; his contribution is noted as "work done under consultancy capacity" for Qualcomm. — UniCaMo is a unified framework for jointly controlling camera motion and object motion in image-and-text-to-video diffusion models.

fields.name: ReelCache: An Efficient KV Cache Compression and Management System for Multi-Round Video Generation
fields.value: Google — ReelCache is a system that compresses and manages the attention key-value (KV) caches of autoregressive video diffusion models during multi-round, interactive video generation.

fields.name: Hierarchical World Models with Implicit Dynamics
fields.value: Meta-FAIR — The paper introduces ID-WM (Implicit Dynamics World Models), a hierarchical world model for embodied planning that separates state-space reachability from local control.

fields.name: Coarse3D: Controllable and Faithful Sparse Structure Generation for Image-to-3D
fields.value: Alibaba Group — Coarse3D is a coarse-stage, sparse-structure generation model for image-to-3D pipelines that produces orientation-controllable, structurally faithful voxel geometry from arbitrary unposed images.

fields.name: Any Forcing: Any-Step Generality and One-Step Stability for Autoregressive Video Generation
fields.value: and Huawei Noah's Ark Institute, Shenzhen); lead affiliation is Xidian University (academic). Huawei is on the tracker's "borderline, keep + flag" list, not the core tracked-company list. (flag) — Any Forcing is a framework for autoregressive (streaming) video generation that supports both flexible sampling-step counts and stable one-step generation, addressing the quality/speed tradeoff and the content drift/collapse that one-step methods suffer over long sequences.

fields.name: LucidLyra: Feed-Forward Generative 3D Scene Reconstruction and Joint Understanding via Multi-Task Distillation
fields.value: NVIDIA — LucidLyra is a feed-forward model that reconstructs a 3D scene as Gaussians while jointly predicting open-vocabulary semantics and class-agnostic instance groupings, all in a single pass from video-diffusion latents.

fields.name: Wizard: Manipulate Any World in Real Time via Agentic Control
fields.value: Tencent — Wizard is an agentic game world model that gives real-time, precise control over character motion in generated game worlds.

fields.name: RFW-A: Agentic Procedural Generation of 400K Articulated Assets over 500 Categories
fields.value: Alibaba Group — RFW-A combines agentic program synthesis with procedural generation: agents build reusable, category-level generator programs from existing articulated-asset code, test and refine them across sampled configurations, then produce assets procedurally without further model calls.

fields.name: PhysAg3D: Bridging 3D Generative and Agentic Models for High-Fidelity and Physically-Interactive Assets
fields.value: Huawei (flag) — PhysAg3D couples 3D generative models with agentic reasoning and tool use to turn a single image into an interactive 3D asset.

fields.name: Aligning Misaligned Benchmarks for Single-View Novel View Synthesis
fields.value: Google — The authors argue that single-view novel-view-synthesis methods are hard to compare fairly because each method's output must first be pose-aligned to ground truth, and common test-time pose optimization is ill-posed, leaving methods evaluated at arbitrary local optima.

fields.name: ETA-Motion: Efficient Topology-Agnostic Motion Diffusion via Sparse Joint Learning
fields.value: Samsung Electronics (flag) — ETA-Motion generates motion for characters with arbitrary, varying skeletons by training a motion generator on only a compact subset of joints rather than all joints.

fields.name: METATRON: A Promptable Whole-Body Execution Layer for Humanoids
fields.value: NVIDIA — Metatron is a humanoid control system built on a frozen, generative whole-body base policy plus a programmable skill layer on top.

fields.name: GOFish: Full Field-of-View Gaussian Splatting and Mesh Extraction
fields.value: Amazon; most likely as an internship collaboration, since other authors hold University of Maryland/Northeastern/CMU affiliations) — GOFish is the first 3D Gaussian Splatting surface reconstruction method that trains directly on fisheye images, rasterizing fields of view beyond 180° and extracting an aligned mesh from the same scene.

fields.name: RynnWorld-Latent: A Cross-Embodiment World Model Conditioned on Universal Latent Actions
fields.value: Alibaba — RynnWorld-Latent is a video world model that uses latent actions from RynnLAM as a shared conditioning interface, letting it train on human videos, robot demonstrations, and simulation rollouts without needing a common action space.

fields.name: GeoGSplat: Geometry-Grounded Non-Pixel-Aligned Gaussian Splatting
fields.value: Horizon Robotics (flag) — GeoGSplat is a feed-forward Gaussian Splatting model for novel view synthesis that adds geometric priors to the non-pixel-aligned framework, which otherwise tends to place Gaussian centers poorly under large viewpoint changes.

fields.name: Hy-Nomas: Towards Free-form Interactive World Generation
fields.value: Tencent — Hy-Nomas is an 8B-parameter diffusion-based video world model that follows free-form text instructions and continuous camera control across multiple interaction turns, generating variable-length video segments from current inputs and cached history.
